scientific_integrity: All parameter claims are derived analytically. Finite exact-arithmetic verification is supplementary, not an infinite proof. Known equal-blade case and existing total-facet counts are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge graph shortest paths and canonical Euclidean zero-sum embedding only; exactly two blades and \(2\le a\le b\).
Does not provide the inequality description or volume of the full optimal-center set.
An equivalent graph-spread formula in differently indexed earlier literature remains possible; independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: An asymmetric two-clique inball transition with parity-switched optimal-center dimensions
